description: This file declares the WorkerThread class and its factory, which are responsible for managing a worker thread that processes player tasks asynchronously. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and private members related to task handling, synchronization, and thread management.

classes.name: WorkerThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating WorkerThread instances, implementing the IWorkerThreadFactory interface.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Implements a worker thread that processes IPlayerTask objects asynchronously, managing thread lifecycle and task queue.

methods.name: createWorkerThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of WorkerThread.

methods.name: WorkerThread
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the WorkerThread object.

methods.name: ~WorkerThread
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the WorkerThread object.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the worker thread to stop processing tasks.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Waits for the worker thread to finish execution.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a new IPlayerTask to the task queue for processing.

methods.name: taskHandler
methods.description: Private method that runs in the worker thread to process tasks from the queue.

methods.name: waitForTask
methods.description: Retrieves the next task from the queue or waits until one is available.
